svg.aria-label: Day 3 hero: a city of green jobs at dawn — wind turbines and solar roofs behind. In front, a big laptop shows a paragraph being edited: “really changing” is crossed out and “undergoing significant transformation” glows in green. On the left, an email to a lecturer flies with a paper plane and comment bubbles say “Maybe we could …” and “Great idea!”. On the right, Seminar Group 1 presents to a small audience in front of a screen, a gold STAR shines, and an AI chat window shows a prompt built from Role, Task, Requirements and Instructions.
